critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated scans report no confirmed violations, no touch-target violations, and no viewport overflow; the mobile 435px section width comes from a clipped decorative element and is not uncontained. The skip-link target measures about 158×46px, and keyboard traversal reaches all horizontal section links with corresponding active hrefs. However, color contrast remains seriously unresolved: the thesis scan has 24 incomplete nodes at every viewport, while document-level scans have 533–597 incomplete nodes because gradients/obscuration prevented measurement. Evidence also covers only the navigation keyboard path, not every thesis action, and provides no reduced-motion test. These missing required proofs prevent an 8.
critique.fix: Measure contrast against the final composited gradient for all thesis text, badges, CTAs, and navigation labels, then adjust colors/backgrounds to meet WCAG thresholds. Add keyboard tests for every thesis control, including visible focus, activation, and skip-link behavior. Test prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and verify that hero/card animations and transitions are disabled or nonessential while content remains visible.
